user_story: As a user, I want to log in to my account using my email and password so that I can access my profile and utilize the services of the application. The login process should validate my credentials and ensure I am redirected to the appropriate page upon successful login.
acceptance_criteria: The login form should contain an input field with id 'email' for entering the email address.
The login form should contain an input field with id 'password' for entering the password.
There should be a submit button with data-test 'login-submit' to submit the login form.
Upon entering valid credentials and submitting the form, the user should be redirected to the specified URL.
If the form is submitted without filling in the required fields, the user should remain on the login page.
